ns2:course.label: Statistical Methods I
ns2:course.description: (PSYCH 306) Techniques in applied statistics used in psychological research, including simple linear regression, partial and multiple correlation, and nonparametric methods; thorough review of statistical estimation and significance tests; emphasizes applied statistics and statistical computing. Introduces experimental design; one-way ANOVA. Credit is not given for both PSYC 406 and SOC 586. Prerequisite: Twelve hours in psychology and PSYC 235, or equivalent.
